methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: VSNavigator is mainly a decision support system, with superior performance to any commercial SCADA.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents the VERYSchool project and the VSNavigator decision-support software (Enerit ISO 50001 suite) for school buildings. EnPI/EnB measurement models are mentioned only incidentally (eeMeasure, IPMVP-customised, IES Building/Climate Energy Index) and none is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach), so it is a tool/software paper without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The VSNavigator is a High-Level Management tool, usable as web-tool with a friendly and intuitive user interface.

stage1.notes: School-buildings sector -> not on the closed continuous-process list, level_3b=false. Reports pilot savings % and named validation tools but no characterised EnPI/EnB model, hence ineligible under the v2.3 tool/software rule. Not a review/synthesis, so borderline flag unset.
